title: Learn IT Support
tagline: From ticket triage to trusted end-user problem solving
description: A three-level curriculum for IT support engineers — diagnosing desktop and identity issues, delivering calm customer service, and escalating with enough detail that engineering and ops can finish the job.
prerequisites: Comfort helping people with computers and common apps
Basic understanding of accounts, passwords, and Wi‑Fi

levels.title: Support Foundations
levels.goal: Triage tickets, resolve common access and device issues, and document clearly

topics.title: Ticket hygiene
items: Gathering repro steps and environment details

topics.title: Accounts & SSO
items: Password resets and MFA resets safely
Least privilege: when not to grant access

topics.title: Email & collaboration
items: Mailbox access, groups, and shared drives

projects: Resolve a mock ticket queue (10 tickets) with proper notes
Write KB articles for password reset and VPN connect
Identity checklist: joiners, movers, leavers for one role
Phishing report drill with escalation to security

levels.title: Reliable Operations Support
levels.goal: Own MDM, endpoint health, and escalations with strong diagnostic depth

topics.title: Security hygiene
items: EDR alerts that support should act on

topics.title: Networking for support
items: When to hand off to network engineering

topics.title: App & SSO failures
items: SAML/OIDC error reading at a support level

topics.title: Knowledge & trends
items: Turning repeat tickets into KB and automation
Weekly incident themes for IT leadership
Major incident comms for end users

projects: MDM enrollment + compliance guide for macOS or Windows
Root-cause write-up for a recurring VPN/SSO outage
Major-incident user comms pack (start, update, resolve)
Ticket trend report with 3 proposed permanent fixes

levels.title: Support Leadership & Systems
levels.goal: Design support operations, improve SLAs, and partner on identity and endpoint strategy

topics.title: Queue & SLA design
items: Measuring CSAT, FCR, and reopen rates

topics.title: Automation
items: Chatbots and forms that collect the right data

topics.title: Workplace technology
items: Office AV and hybrid meeting reliability
Budget awareness for licenses and devices

topics.title: Coaching & influence
items: Training L1 analysts and shadowing quality
Partnering with security without blocking users

projects: L1/L2/L3 playbook with routing and escalation SLAs
Joiner-mover-leaver design with HR and identity owners
Self-service catalog proposal that cuts top 5 ticket types
Quarterly IT support OKRs with baseline metrics
